caption: Talk
lines: The community can activate a global EXP Event.
Donate Exp Event Coins and I will count every contribution.
The first 500 coins start +10% EXP for 60 minutes.
You can find Exp Event Coins on monsters.
Multiple players can contribute to the same event.
Every further 500 coins during the event add 10 percentage points and 15 minutes.
The bonus is capped at 50%; further donations still add 15 minutes per 500 coins.
Donate all your coins or exactly 100. The noticeboard shows the current progress.
